estimands.table_run: Probability that a sampled injected table-seed run is detected under the three fixed injection seeds.
estimands.source_table_uid_equal: Mean of each source-table UID's detection proportion across the seeds in which that UID is injected, weighting UIDs equally.
estimands.seed_generalization: Not estimated reliably because only three injection seeds are available; report the three rates and leave-one-seed-out values.

ruling.retained_text: The denominator-weighted table-run estimate 219/282 = 0.7766 is retained as a descriptive result.
ruling.recommended_interval: Use the source-table UID-cluster bootstrap interval and the three-seed range/leave-one-seed-out sensitivity. Keep the old [0.7270, 0.8227] only as a historical naive table-run interval, not as a source-table uncertainty interval.
